message.reasoning:
I've got the full orange monopoly but all mortgaged, with $306 cash, while p4 has $463 and a built-up Mediterranean/Baltic set plus other holdings. Unmortgaging the oranges would cost around $308, just out of reach for building, but they're the strongest set on the board, so letting p4 acquire them would make them dangerous. I'm weighing p4's offer of $200 plus Marvin Gardens against that risk.

Marvin Gardens and North Carolina don't complete any monopoly for me since the rest of those color groups are scattered among other players, so the deal is basically cash-equivalent while handing p4 a long-term monopoly. Given my weak position against p2's developed Boardwalk/Park Place, I'd rather hold the oranges and slowly unmortgage them myself than give p4 that advantage, so I'll reject or push for a much bigger counteroffer.

function.name: reject_trade
function.arguments: {"public_message": "No thanks. The oranges stay with me. I'll unmortgage them and build."}
